turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you hear me okay?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Clearer if you face me and talk slowly.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Tell me what brought you in today.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My chest has been troubling me.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: When did this start?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It began yesterday afternoon.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you describe the pain for me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It feels like a heavy weight sitting on my chest.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does the pain spread anywhere, like your arm or jaw?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, it stays right where it is.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does anything make it better?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have not taken anything for it.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does it come on when you are active?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, walking up the hill makes it come on.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you get sweaty or clammy when it happens?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I get clammy.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you short of breath when this happens?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I feel winded.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you fainted or felt like you might pass out?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sorry, what did you say?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you smoke, or have high blood pressure, diabetes or high cholesterol?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have high blood pressure. I have never smoked.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Has anyone in your family had heart trouble at a young age?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, not that I know of.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you ever had a heart procedure, like a stent or bypass surgery?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I have not had any heart procedures.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you tell me your daily medicines?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Lisinopril.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Before you go, let me go over the plan. First, come back to this clinic in one week. Second, bring your medicine bottles to your next visit.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Is there anything else you want to ask me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, that is all, thank you.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Take care, and we will see you soon.
